commands.label: isolated-run-help
commands.stdout:
usage: testpilot run [-h] --repo REPO (--diff DIFF | --git-base GIT_BASE)
                     [--backend {scripted,tokenfactory,openai}]
                     [--script SCRIPT] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--rounds ROUNDS]
                     [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--no-coverage] [--python EXECUTABLE]
                     [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--pytest-k EXPR]
                     [--pytest-m EXPR] [--progress] [--out OUT]
                     [--target PATH.py::QUALNAME]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --diff DIFF           unified diff file ('-' for stdin)
  --git-base GIT_BASE   diff the working tree against this git ref
  --backend {scripted,tokenfactory,openai}
                        default: $TESTPILOT_BACKEND or scripted
  --script SCRIPT       dir of canned responses for the scripted backend
  --base-url BASE_URL   override OpenAI-compatible base URL
  --rounds ROUNDS       max repair rounds (default 3)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     positive finite pytest timeout per run, seconds
  --no-coverage         run pytest without optional coverage measurement
                        (default: automatic when installed)
  --python EXECUTABLE   project Python for all test runs; path or PATH command
                        (default: this interpreter)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        total token budget for the run
  --pytest-k EXPR       native pytest keyword expression for baseline,
                        generation and every repair
  --pytest-m EXPR       native pytest marker expression for baseline,
                        generation and every repair
  --progress            show live phase notices on stderr
  --out OUT
  --target PATH.py::QUALNAME
                        select this function explicitly; repeat for caller
                        order, instead of automatic diff selection
